<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 180.0423, which in positive‑mode ESI likely corresponds to [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈179.03498 Da. Searching for a formula composed of C, H, O and one other element that matches this exact mass within high‑resolution tolerance, the best fit is C₇H₅N₃O₃ (exact mass 179.03309 Da, ~10 ppm from the observed value). The isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1, ~1 % M+2) is consistent with a molecule containing about seven carbons. Hence the molecular formula is C7H5N3O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H5N3O3</final_answer>
